name: FormEncoder
title: a media encoder with a queue, presets and its own Rust engine
summary: A media encoder with a parallel queue, 93 encoding presets, 40 formats, watch folders and publishing, on its own Rust engine driving a pinned LGPL FFmpeg.
lede: FormEncoder is the media encoder of the form family, beside FormCut (video), FormVFX (motion graphics), FormWav (audio) and FormVis (images), for the desktop and the browser. It queues sources with several outputs each and encodes them in parallel.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux, as a desktop app or in the browser
checks: Encodes a queue of sources with several outputs each, in parallel, with undo.
Ships 93 encoding presets and 5 ingest presets across web, social, devices, broadcast, cinema, DVD and Blu-ray, image sequences, GIF, audio, archive and proxies.
Covers 40 formats from H.264, HEVC, AV1 and WebM to ProRes, DNxHR, CineForm, XDCAM and JPEG 2000 MXF.
Queues work from FormCut, FormVFX, FormWav and FormVis running on the same computer.

facts.dd: FormEncoder's own, in Rust (seven fencoder crates in native/), driving a pinned LGPL FFmpeg 7.1.5
186 files and 23,021 lines in total, per the README table
Hardware encoders (VideoToolbox, Media Foundation, NVENC, AMF, VA-API), or Cisco's OpenH264 downloaded in Preferences, never bundled

chapters.title: A queue with several outputs per source
chapters.text: Drag media into the Queue, drag presets from the Preset Browser onto a source to add outputs, and press Start. Cmd or Ctrl+K searches every command.

chapters.title: Every setting, with a preview
chapters.text: Click a preset to open Export Settings: Source, Output and Compare views, every setting, effects, captions, metadata, publish and the estimated size.

chapters.title: Part of the form family
chapters.text: FormEncoder finds FormCut, FormVFX, FormWav and FormVis running on the same computer and queues their work. Finished files can go back to FormCut or FormVFX from the Queue.

parity.summary: FormEncoder is traced against 84 Media Encoder capabilities, with HandBrake, Shutter Encoder and Compressor compared beside it. The README states 84 traced rows: 82 Full, 2 Partial, 0 None. The Partial rows are AVC-Intra and vendor camera raw.

items: The About box and the installers name NodeAgentc, Inc. as the publisher, with the Apache-2.0 licence
The updater reads its feed from the download store
The Windows desktop app no longer opens to a blank window on PCs where the .js file type is set to text/plain
The pinned FFmpeg download names nodemode-dev/formcut-binaries
Desktop builds for FormCompiler's signed releases; the app itself does not change
On macOS, bundled programs and libraries are signed before the bundle is made so the app can be notarized
